services.desc: The best way to experience Chattanooga, the River City! Rates Paddleboard $99 Single Kayak $99 Tandem Kayak $149 About Get ready for a great day on the water! Enjoy the greatest features of our Scenic City via kayak or paddleboard and explore what the downtown Chattanooga portion of the Tennessee River has in store. Paddle around Maclellan island, cliffs below Hunter Museum, see our famous Walnut Street walking bridge and the Tennessee Aquarium. It's always a great day on the river with L2 Outside.
